map.收获规划器，安排收获期、劳动力需求、机械效率与进度，辅助规模化采收的人机调度与工: Harvest planner: schedule the harvest period, labour needs, machine efficiency and progress to assist labour-machine scheduling and timeline control in large-scale harvesting.
map.总产量 = 面积 × 单产 ÷ 1000（吨）；日作业量 = 面积 ÷ 计划天数: Total output = area x yield per unit / 1000 (tonnes); daily workload = area / planned days; labourers = ceil(daily workload / (per-person daily efficiency x hours/8)); machines = ceil(daily workload / machine daily efficiency)
map.按收获方式规划用工与机械：人工收获按「日作业量 ÷ 人均日效率」定人数；机械收获: Plan labour and machinery by harvest method: for manual harvesting set headcount as 'daily workload / per-person daily efficiency'; for machine harvesting set the number of machines as 'daily workload / machine daily efficiency'; for combined machine plus manual, split the area 70%/30%. Cost is computed from labour hour charges and per-mu machine fees, and converted into cost per unit area and cost per unit output (CNY/kg).
map.按各地块成熟度（GDD/含水率）与机械资源排程收获顺序。: Schedule the harvest order by each plot's maturity (GDD/moisture content) and machine resources.
map.平衡『先熟先收』与『避雨抢收』。: Balance 'harvest the earliest first' against 'rush in before the rain'.
map.用于多地块、多品种协同调度。: For coordinated scheduling across multiple plots and varieties.
map.：A 地 3 天后达蜡熟、B 地 6 天、C 地 9 天；一台收割机日作业 80: : Plot A reaches the dough stage in 3 days, B in 6 and C in 9; one harvester covers 80 mu per day. Prioritize in the order A -> B -> C; if rain is forecast for day 5, bring B forward and push C back to avoid A and B becoming over-mature and shattering at the same time.
map.不能全替代。它把『成熟度、机械、天气』量化排程，但临田判断（倒伏、病斑）仍需人定: Not a full replacement. It quantifies and schedules 'maturity, machinery, weather', but in-field judgement (lodging, disease spots) still requires a person. It supports decisions rather than executing them automatically.
map.机械故障怎么办？: What if a machine breaks down?
map.规划应留缓冲（如日作业按 70% 能力排），并预备代耕或跨区调配。关键期『宁可早: Planning should leave a buffer (for example schedule daily work at 70% of capacity) and prepare for custom hiring or cross-region reallocation. In the critical period, 'better to harvest slightly early and slightly green than late with shattering'.
